ops.body: A3.5 H2 policy decision (check-back from athome-a3, resolved by fable): FULL inversion, both recovered_cost callers — the wall-cancel recovery AND the driver's internal timeout path. One rule: an interrupted/killed proposal may journal-and-continue only when its spend is exactly known (complete parseable envelope); otherwise AccountingIntegrityError. Rejected option B (scope inversion to wall-cancel only, keep the timeout path lenient): it codifies the assume-zero branch rounds 2–3 eliminated — a hung agent that made API calls has spend exactly as unknown as a wall-cancelled one, and a REPEATING hang in an autonomous campaign leaks unbounded unaccounted spend, breaking A6b reservation arithmetic. Rejected option C (empty-log-at-timeout = zero): an empty log doesn't prove no billing — the same argument H2 rests on. Consequences: ProposalTimeout with a complete envelope keeps CRASH+real-cost+continue (resilient case survives exactly when accounting is intact — new test); FAKE_CLAUDE_HANGS-style no-envelope timeout now aborts (two tests updated to assert the abort + M1 marker); pre-spawn cancel stays zero. Resilience loss is bounded and operable via the M1 breadcrumb + resume-refusal flow, and matches the recorded A6b lean (campaign-halt on accounting aborts).
